authorship.lesson_policy: Create original DreamCo explanations, examples, exercises, projects, assessments, and rubrics. Do not copy source wording, distinctive lesson structure, slides, code examples, or transcripts.
authorship.source_policy: Maintain an internal provenance and rights ledger for every external learning input. Learner-facing lessons may use DreamCo course titles and original wording, but attribution and license obligations must not be concealed or removed.

permissions.independent_original_instruction: author from independently verified knowledge and first-party examples

learning_contract.mastery_rule: A lesson being read or summarized never counts as capability mastery. Promotion requires reproducible test evidence and an unseen transfer task.
learning_contract.execution_safety: Run generated code in isolated, resource-bounded sandboxes with no production credentials, no unrestricted network access, explicit tool allowlists, and human approval for external side effects.
learning_contract.training_boundary: Course completion, retrieval practice, tool-use improvement, and model-weight training are separate states. No weight update occurs without separately authorized data, compute, and experiment approval.

tracks.title: Computational Thinking and Algorithm Design
tracks.capstone: Implement and benchmark a tested algorithm toolkit against unseen inputs.

tracks.title: Software Construction and AI-Assisted Engineering
tracks.capstone: Build a bounded coding assistant that opens a reviewable change and supplies test evidence without merging it.

tracks.title: API and Integration Engineering
tracks.capstone: Build and test a permission-aware service integration with retries, rate limits, and audit logs.

tracks.title: Data Platforms, SQL, and Semantic Retrieval
tracks.capstone: Create a PostgreSQL-backed knowledge service with evaluated keyword, vector, and hybrid retrieval.

tracks.title: System Design and Distributed Architecture
tracks.capstone: Design, implement, load-test, and document a resilient service with measured trade-offs.

tracks.title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning Engineering
tracks.capstone: Run a reproducible baseline-versus-candidate experiment with held-out evaluation and rollback evidence.

tracks.title: Cloud Engineering, CI/CD, and Reliability
tracks.capstone: Build a CI pipeline that detects a seeded failure, diagnoses it, proposes an isolated fix, and opens a tested pull request.

tracks.title: Web and Application Engineering
tracks.capstone: Ship an accessible full-stack application with automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.

tracks.title: Application Security, Privacy, and Governance
tracks.capstone: Threat-model and harden an agent workflow, then pass adversarial and secret-leakage tests.

tracks.title: Data Analysis and Practical Automation
tracks.capstone: Build a reliable, permission-aware data pipeline with validation, monitoring, and a useful report.

intensive_seven_day_plan.exit_gate: Buddy can explain and solve foundational tasks with tests.
Working application and service pass automated tests.
Queries, constraints, and retrieval benchmarks pass.
Agent completes a safe task and refuses disallowed actions.
Pipeline detects failures and produces reproducible diagnostics.
Experiment is reproducible and reports limitations honestly.
Only capabilities with passing evidence are marked mastered.

throughput_policy.batching: Process catalog records in resumable, deterministic batches with checkpointed cursors.
throughput_policy.parallelism: Use bounded matrix workers and concurrency groups; do not assume a fixed runner-minute allowance or exceed the repository's configured budget.
throughput_policy.timebox: A seven-day sprint can produce an operational first version and validated priority skills. It cannot honestly certify mastery of every topic or every long-form lesson in the inventory.
throughput_policy.completion_reporting: Publish per-track queue, completed labs, passed and failed tests, blocked permissions, unresolved items, and evidence links.

integration_contract.policy: Extend existing catalog, scheduler, study worker, course registry, Actions interface, and evidence pipeline. Do not create duplicate catalogs or claim the runtime is active until workflows and integration tests verify it.
